CIRC-001 continuous circulation (PROTOTYPE): per ring 159 m of corridor in the three fills, 9 sliding pressure doors (red: sector side walls, blue: spoke-node bulkheads), 9 compartments (3 sectors, 6 corridor halves).
Corridor clear 0.90 x 2.10 m, level floor at r 28.152 m (flush with the sector deck edge); doors 0.65 x 1.95 m; through-passage in every sector at x -1.15..-0.50 m.
Pressurized +338 m3 per ring: both rings 434 -> 1111 m3 gross against the BASELINE 400-460 m3 (x2.42); atmosphere +641 kg.
Mass ~40.2 t both rings, 12.2 % of the 330 t rotating allowance (unbudgeted; 301 t at the sectors' areal mass). Conflicts: 12!A13, the 400-460 m3 envelope, 330 t (ring_circulation.conflicts).
Shaded: corridor compartments; dashed: the walking circuit; amber: pressurized sectors; grey: frame (hoops and fills: water, storage, structure).
